limitations: No independent model inference was run.

No new CPU BA reconstruction from checkpoint tensors was performed in this audit; drift was cross-checked against raw mechanism delta_norm, local endpoint measurements, and historical summaries/trajectory records. The original report separately records CPU checkpoint-based drift reconstruction.
Raw t01[0][1] and undefined future/backward summary positions contain expected NaN placeholders; these are excluded from observed accuracy and loss validity checks.

Training receipts cover all 50 shuffled loader passes and their indices/first augmented batch; the trainer text log records the final epoch. This audit does not assert finite per-step values that were never logged.

Historical SGD paths have no GAM gradient-decomposition fields; all logged numeric mechanism fields and all native required loss fields were checked. Auxiliary train256 trace remeasurement in Task-1 shaping seed2 differs by 3.96e-9; it is within floating-point tolerance and does not affect B1 or any displayed value.
